summary: TestQuantityParse now iterates a shared quantityTestcases() generator instead of a local table, and adds assertions that ParseQuantity caches the string and that String() returns the expected canonical form. It is test-only and matches the new ParseQuantity caching, so a short summary is enough.
headline: TestQuantityParse uses shared testcases and asserts cached canonical string
reason: Test-only change that adds assertions and reuses a shared table; no production code is touched and no assertions are removed or weakened.
